title.narrative: Internews: Media Literacy and Moldovan Media 2022-2025
Internews: Media Literacy and Moldovan Media 2022-2025

description.narrative: Insatsen kommer att bidra till att uppnå resultat under målområde nr. 1: "Mänskliga rättigheter, demokrati, rättsstatsprincipen och jämställdhet: Bättre demokratisk samhällsstyrning och respekt för mänskliga rättigheter och rättsstatsprincipen". För att säkerställa att alla människor är fullt bemyndigade med de nyheter och information de behöver fokuserar Internews på konsolidering av civilsamhället och stödjande av processer för icke-statliga organisationers koalitioner, i syfte att främja demokratiska principer och värderingar i Republiken Moldavien.

The intervention will contribute to the achievement of outputs under result area nr. 1 "Human rights, democracy, the rule of law and gender equality: Better democratic governance and respect for human rights and the rule of law". To ensure that all people are fully empowered with the news and information they need, Internews concentrates on consolidation of civil society and supporting the processes of non-governmental organizations' coalitions in order to promote democratic principles and values in the Republic of Moldova.

The overall objective of the Project is to contribute towards the growth of a diverse, independent and financially viable media landscape in Moldova and to empower Moldovan youth to navigate their complex information environment.
The design of the activities, and the implementation approach have been developed as a direct result of the periodic organisational capacity assessment conducted by Internews on all key partners. The activities are structured in the following groups planned to be implemented during 36 months:
SO1: Consolidate financial sustainability, editorial development and management support to independent media outlets Using the evidence-based approach, Internews will provide support to regional and national key partner media through sub-granting and tailored mentoring and consulting to 1) widen the reach of regional key partner media, their engagement with audiences and financial sustainability; 2) consolidate the support provided to national key partner media and bolster their capacity for financial independence. Internews previous project work has demonstrated that the most efficient way to support change within partner newsrooms is through intensive tailored mentoring.
SO2: Strengthen the media literacy and critical thinking of Moldovan youth, including vulnerable groups Internews will issue a sub-grant to IJC to lead on the activities within SO2. The project will improve the media literacy tools by 1) revising the outdated Media Education textbooks and digitising them, 2) supporting teachers to integrate the new tools in teaching, 3) opening access to Media Education tools for children with special needs by providing them with accessible textbooks and video lessons.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative:
/2023/ Following the Specific Objective 1: Consolidate financial sustainability, editorial development and management support to independent media outlets, Internews used the evidence-based approach and provided support to regional and national key partner media through sub-granting and tailored mentoring and consulting. Through activities implemented during 2023, it was aimed to 1) widen the reach of regional key partner media, their engagement with audiences and financial sustainability; 2) consolidate the support provided to national key partner media and bolster their capacity for financial independence.
Following the Specific Objective 2: Strengthen the media literacy and critical thinking of Moldovan youth and vulnerable groups, Internews issued a sub-grant to Independent Journalism Center to lead on media literacy activities. Dedicated activities were implemented to improve the media literacy tools by 1) revising the outdated Media Education textbooks and digitising them, 2) supporting teachers to integrate the new tools in teaching, 3) opening access to Media Education tools for children with special needs by providing them with accessible textbooks and video lessons.
/2024/ Following the Specific Objective 1: Consolidate financial sustainability, editorial development and management support to independent media outlets, Internews continued to provide support to regional (6) and national key partner media (5). Financial and editorial sustainability of 11 key media partners (regional and national) was strengthened during the year.
Association of Independent Press supported Audiovisual Council in monitoring the compliance of audiovisual media service providers with the Central Electoral Commision`s Regulation on coverage of elections during the presidential elections and constitutional referendum.
Following the Specific Objective 2: Strengthen the media literacy and critical thinking of Moldovan youth and vulnerable groups, Independent Journalism Center (IJC) completed the revision of media education textbooks. Media literacy and critical thinking was enhanced among youth and vulnerable groups through textbook revision, digitization, and Braille translation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
